title_tag: 8 Best Hotels in Budapest (2026): 3 to 5 Stars Compared
meta_description: The best hotels in Budapest at every budget: 3, 4 and 5 stars compared on guest scores, value, location and price per night, from €89 to €187.
h1_main: 8 Best Hotels in Budapest for Every Budget
author_role: 8 hotels from 3 to 5 stars compared on guest scores, value for money, location and price for the same night
lead: The best hotel in Budapest is the one that fits your trip: a 9.5-rated riverside hotel for under €150 (that is Hotel Vision, the #1 pick, €147), a 5-star with a spa for €124, a 9.2-rated room on Andrássy Avenue for €94, or a well-run 3-star in the Jewish Quarter for €89. Not sure which district? Start with where to stay in Budapest. This page gets you to the right hotel in under a minute.

To make the choice easy, I compared all 8 on what decides a hotel booking: the guest score and how many reviews it rests on, value for money, location score and the walk to the sights, spa or sauna, and the price for the same night, checked on each hotel's own listing. Filter by star rating, price or the river below, or scroll straight to the ranking.

guide.h2: The 8 Best Hotels Side by Side
guide.html:
Prices are for the same night (Wednesday 10 March 2027, 2 adults, 1 room). Scores are out of 10; the number in brackets is the review count.

What the numbers say: Budapest's best hotels are unusually close in quality: all eight score 9.0 or higher on thousands of reviews. The real differences are price (€89 to €187 for the same night) and what is in the building. A 4-star like Oktogon Haggenmacher at €94 scores 9.2 for value; you need to go to the 5-stars for a spa (Áurea Ana Palace) or a pool (Kempinski).

• Best overall: #1 Hotel Vision.
  • 5-star for a 4-star price: #2 Áurea Ana Palace (€124).
  • Best value under €100: #3 Oktogon Haggenmacher.
  • First visit, walk everywhere: #4 Three Corners Downtown.
  • Couples who want Buda and the Chain Bridge: #5 Hotel Clark (adults only).
  • Cheapest well-rated stay: #7 Roombach (€89).
  • A pool: #8 Kempinski.

Looking for something specific? Compare the luxury hotels, boutique hotels, spa hotels or cheap hotels.

guide.h2: Before You Book: Areas, Check-in and Breakfast
guide.html:
Areas: seven of the eight are on the Pest side in Districts V, VI and VII. Hotel Clark is on the Buda side at the end of the Chain Bridge, below the castle.

Check-in: from 2 pm at Vision, Three Corners and Clark, 2:30 pm at Oktogon, 3 pm at Roombach and Kempinski.

Breakfast: guests rate it wonderful at Three Corners and excellent at most of the others; whether it is included depends on the rate you book.

Getting in: see Budapest airport to the city centre. Arriving late or leaving early? Compare the airport hotels.

faqs.q: What is the best hotel in Budapest?
faqs.a: Hotel Vision Budapest: 9.5 from 4,534 reviews, on the Danube embankment in District V, for €147 on a March weeknight.

faqs.q: What is the best value hotel in Budapest?
faqs.a: Hotel Oktogon Haggenmacher on Andrássy Avenue: 9.2 from 6,609 reviews and 9.2 for value, at €94. For a 5-star, Áurea Ana Palace costs €124.

faqs.q: Which area of Budapest is best for a first visit?
faqs.a: District V on the Pest side, around the Basilica: Three Corners Downtown is a 3-minute walk from St Stephen's Basilica and scores 9.9 for location. See where to stay in Budapest for every area.

faqs.q: How much is a good hotel in Budapest per night?
faqs.a: On a March weeknight for 2 adults, €89 (Roombach, 3 stars) to €187 (Kempinski, 5 stars) for hotels scoring 9.0 or higher.

faqs.q: Is there a good adults-only hotel in Budapest?
faqs.a: Hotel Clark is a 5-star, adults-only hotel at the Buda end of the Chain Bridge, scoring 9.3.

methodology: We compared Budapest hotels scoring 9.0 or higher on at least 1,700 reviews, across 3, 4 and 5 stars, on the price for the same night (10 March 2027, 2 adults), guest score, value and location sub-scores, wellness facilities, check-in times and the walk to the sights, all from each hotel's live listing.
